degasser_operations.label: Degas — Stage 1
degasser_operations.rationale: O2-sensitive: Photoredox Giese radical addition (C–C bond formation)

deoxygenation_method: Offline argon sparging of all Stage 1 feed solutions (EtOH/pH 9 buffer 5:1 v/v) for ≥20 min; transfer to sealed glass reservoirs with argon headspace; maintain argon blanket on reservoirs during entire run. No inline degasser used (forbidden by hard constraint). Purge Stage 1 tubing with degassed solvent before reaction start.
pre_reactor_steps: Offline argon sparging of EtOH/pH 9 buffer (5:1 v/v) for ≥20 min before preparing feed solutions — required because no inline degasser is available (hard constraint). Chemistry Plan deoxygenation_reasoning: O2 quenches α-thiomethyl radical I.
Transfer pre-degassed solutions to sealed glass reservoirs; purge headspace with argon and maintain argon blanket throughout the run.
Purge all Stage 1 tubing (from pump heads to Stage 1 reactor outlet) with pre-degassed solvent under argon before starting the reaction to displace any residual O2.
Verify Stage 2 T-junction (T2) is downstream of Stage 1 reactor outlet before opening air feed.

stage_2_air_streams.pump_role: Gas feed introducing air (O2 source) at T-junction between Stage 1 and Stage 2 reactors
stage_2_air_streams.reasoning: Deterministic gas stoichiometry: inlet/STP MFC flow was recomputed from target gas equivalents (1.00 equiv), liquid flow 0.20643 mL/min, and substrate concentration. Pressure-corrected in-channel gas flow is reported separately; supplied gas equiv = 1.00.
